summary: Probably John's 1st cousin 6x removed; pioneer of Union (Hunlock) Township.
bio: Son of Philip; John Croup/Croop (1783-1850), pioneer of Union (Hunlock) Twp with a 200-acre lot; married Elizabeth Sorber, daughter of Abraham Sorber (Plumb). The Croop mills descend from him.
